map.→ 打开电路负载计算工具: -> Open the circuit load calculator tool
map.一个新回路带空调+插座，汇总设备功率算电流，选对应空开与线径（如 2.5㎡ 铜线: A new circuit with air conditioning plus sockets: total the equipment power to get the current, then pick the matching breaker and cable size (for example 2.5 mm2 copper is about 16 A).
map.不建议。强电有触电与火灾风险，须由持证电工按 GB 50054/50096 等规: Not recommended. Strong current work carries shock and fire risk and must be designed, installed and accepted by a licensed electrician per standards such as GB 50054/50096.
map.常用经验：1.5㎡≈10–13A、2.5㎡≈16–20A、4㎡≈25–32A（明: Common rules of thumb: 1.5 mm2 ≈ 10-13 A, 2.5 mm2 ≈ 16-20 A, 4 mm2 ≈ 25-32 A (surface mounted, room temperature). Conduit runs, high temperatures and long distances require derating.
map.排查频繁跳闸，用本工具反推是否超载或线径偏小，定位改造点。: Investigate frequent tripping by back-calculating whether the load is exceeded or the cable too small, to locate what needs upgrading.
map.末端压降一般控制在不超 5%（220V 下约 11V）。超了需加粗线径或缩短距离: Keep the end voltage drop within 5% (about 11 V at 220 V). Beyond that, use a thicker cable or shorten the run.

map.输入用电总功率、供电电压与功率因数，计算线路工作电流并推荐断路器规格与导线截面积: Enter the total power, the supply voltage and the power factor to compute the circuit working current and recommend the breaker size and cable cross-section, for circuit design.
map.远距离供电时用线径与长度核算电压降，防止末端电器欠压无法启动。: For a long power run, use the cable size and length to check the voltage drop, so the appliance at the far end does not fail to start on undervoltage.
